convertibility_reason: No custom indicators used. No external .mqh libraries for trading logic (only standard MT5 Trade library includes). Simple entry (single Buy on first tick) and exit logic (virtual SL/TP/breakeven). Fixed lot sizing. All logic is position management with price comparisons.

other_exits: Breakeven: when Ask exceeds open_price + ExtBreakeven*Point for BUY (or Bid below open_price - ExtBreakeven*Point for SELL), SL is moved to open_price + ExtBreakMinDis*Point (BUY) or open_price - ExtBreakMinDis*Point (SELL). Only applied when current SL is 0.
Virtual SL/TP: positions are closed via PositionClose when price crosses calculated SL or TP levels, not via broker-set SL/TP orders. SL/TP arrows are drawn on chart but not set on the trade server.

position_sizing.conditional_logic: Only one initial Buy (0.01 lots) is opened on the very first tick. No subsequent entries. The EA only manages the existing position.

custom_logic_notes: This EA opens a single Buy(0.01) on the first tick and then only manages that position. It uses virtual SL/TP/breakeven — price levels are checked in OnTick and positions are closed via PositionClose, not via actual stop-loss or take-profit orders set on the broker. The breakeven is a one-time move of SL to open_price + ExtBreakMinDis*Point (for BUY) when price reaches open_price + ExtBreakeven*Point, and only when the current SL is 0. No SELL entry logic exists — the EA only goes long on first tick. Chart objects (arrows) are drawn to visualize SL/TP/Breakeven levels. Magic number filtering allows managing positions across all EAs (Magic=0) or specific ones.
python_conversion_notes: Very simple EA. Opens one Buy on first tick, then monitors price vs virtual SL/TP/breakeven levels each tick. No indicators to convert. Key logic: (1) digit adjustment multiply by 10 for 3/5 digit brokers; (2) virtual SL/TP closes position when price crosses threshold — must check Ask for BUY TP/SL trigger and Bid for SELL TP/SL trigger; (3) breakeven moves SL only once (when current SL==0). Standard MT5 Trade library classes (CPositionInfo, CTrade, CSymbolInfo, CDealInfo) map to simple broker API calls in Python. No new-bar guard, checks every tick. The hardcoded 0.01 lot and Buy-only entry make this a trivial conversion. Note: the EA has no SELL entry — it only manages existing positions including SELL if manually opened.
